note: Rio Grande NF (Saguache RD) at the base of Storm King Mountain, in an aspen glen on the Middle Fork of Carnero Creek, ~9,500 ft. Access is CR 41G / FR 690 over Carnero Pass: dirt, single lane with turnouts inside the forest. --Claude
summary: FS campground page: confirmed 6 sites, 25-ft trailer limit, vault toilet, no water, FCFS, $10, Saguache RD phone 719-655-2547. Added season (mid-May to mid-November), the forest's 14-day limit and the senior/access 50%. Note cleaned of field facts. Not waterfront kept.
flags: Phone 719-655-2547 confirmed (Saguache Ranger District, on the FS page).
Length: FS 'Maximum trailer length is 25 feet.' and 'Parking is limited in the campground area.' A 25-ft limit clears EKKO (23 ft).

Road: FS 'County Road 41G (FR 690) becomes dirt and narrows to single-lane with turnouts after entering the National Forest. Motorized access to the picnic area may be restricted by snow and seasonal road closures from March 15 to May 15.' Saguache Roads Status (last updated 5/11/2026): 41G Carnero 'Open' with comment 'Heavy Logging activity'; 690.2a Storm King Campground 'Open'. No 4WD or high-clearance wording.

Flood alert (Rio Grande NF, Oct 23 2026, updated Oct 26): 'Heavy rain throughout Southwest Colorado that started on October 22nd, 2026, has caused extremely dangerous conditions on the Rio Grande National Forest ... widespread flooding, mudslides, winter weather, and road, trail, and infrastructure damage ... We encourage the public to avoid venturing out to the Forest when possible.' Nothing names Carnero Creek or FR 690; the campground page still reads 'open until November 2026'. Not recorded as a closure.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront, kept): the Middle Fork of Carnero Creek is a few metres wide (creekside-sized), running through the aspen band on the camp's south-east side; the sites sit under the aspens and can't be placed on leaf-off imagery, so creekside could not be confirmed and the call stays down.
